newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks pass through 1,500 points.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks pass through 1,500 points.

text.p: Stocks moved past 1,500 points on Monday on selective buying by investors and institutional support after the government said it would announce a relief package for stock markets, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 10.45 points, or 0.70 percent, to 1,500.56 by midsession. Gainers led losers 156 to 118.
"Local investors and institutions are buying undervalued stocks," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said. "The index has moved up in anticipation of the relief package for the stock market."
